question: Compare the indexed evidence for the resident-individual tax-free threshold in AY 2025–26 and AY 2026–27 in a two-row table. Give each year’s source and calculate the difference only if both years are established; do not substitute a later schedule for a missing year.

requirements.description: Establish the applicable ordinary resident-individual category and assessment year for AY 2025–26.
Establish the applicable ordinary resident-individual category and assessment year for AY 2026–27.
Establish the resident-individual tax-free threshold for AY 2025–26.
Establish the resident-individual tax-free threshold for AY 2026–27.
Calculate the difference between the two thresholds only if both are established.

checks.description: Establish the applicable ordinary resident-individual category and assessment year for AY 2025–26.
checks.answerable_scope: The 2025–26 tax-year schedule applies to individuals other than non-resident individuals who are not Bangladeshi.

checks.description: Establish the applicable ordinary resident-individual category and assessment year for AY 2026–27.
checks.answerable_scope: The 2026–27 schedule applies to all individuals, including non-resident Bangladeshis, and therefore includes resident individuals.

checks.description: Establish the resident-individual tax-free threshold for AY 2025–26.
checks.answerable_scope: The ordinary resident-individual tax-free threshold for AY 2025–26 is BDT 350,000, as shown in the 2025–26 rate schedule.

checks.description: Establish the resident-individual tax-free threshold for AY 2026–27.
checks.answerable_scope: The ordinary resident-individual tax-free threshold for AY 2026–27 is BDT 400,000, as shown in the enacted Finance Act 2026 schedule.

checks.description: Calculate the difference between the two thresholds only if both are established.
checks.answerable_scope: The difference between the two established thresholds can be calculated from their separately scoped amounts.
